page.overview:
Who is Captain Jack Harkness?

Captain Jack Harkness belongs to Doctor Who. "Captain Jack Harkness" was the alias adopted by the human Time Agent and con man Javic Piotr Thane (AUDIO:, ) from the Boeshane Peninsula in the 51st century.

He was a companion of the Ninth Doctor, and an associate of the Sixth, Tenth and Thirteenth Doctors. Originally a Time Agent, Harkness lost his memories of his previous life and became a con artist.

Upon meeting the Ninth Doctor and Rose Tyler in 1941, he tried to scam them into buying a Chula ambulance, having mistaken them for fellow Time Agents.

Also known as: Captain Jack, Jack Harkness.
